name: duopore-public-quote-unit-cost-normalization
description: Turn pack prices into a price per unit so different quotes are easier to compare.

interface.longDescription: Turn pack prices into a price per unit so different quotes are easier to compare. Enter each pack's price, how much it holds and the total amount you need. See prices in the same base unit and the cost for your chosen quantity before fees. You must use units that mean the same thing and one currency. No exchange rates are fetched.
defaultPrompt: Compare these pack quotes by price per unit.
What does my required quantity cost at each quoted unit price?

positive.prompt: Use Quote Unit Cost Normalize with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"baseUnit":"sheet","comparisonUnits":100,"quotes":[{"id":"Q1","unitsPerPackage":50,"packagePrice":25},{"id":"Q2","unitsPerPackage":20,"packagePrice":12}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"2 package quotes normalized per sheet.","rows":[{"id":"Q1","unitsPerPackage":50,"packagePrice":25,"rank":1,"baseUnit":"sheet","pricePerBaseUnit":0.5,"comparisonUnits":100,"proportionalCost":50},{"id":"Q2","unitsPerPackage":20,"packagePrice":12,"rank":2,"baseUnit":"sheet","pricePerBaseUnit":0.6,"comparisonUnits":100,"proportionalCost":60}],"warnings":["Compare supplied figures in one currency for the same specification. No supplier verification, negotiation, ordering or payment occurs.","Unit prices retain numeric precision. Proportional costs round to two decimals and permit fractional packages; actual packs, minimum quantities and extra fees need separate checks."]}
